comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Left (15) returns 1 when any comment engages a specific OP-cited example or premise, whether by quoting, paraphrasing or naming it. Right (54) returns 1 only when a comment reproduces OP wording verbatim or near-verbatim as a quotation, and paraphrase does not count. Their null rules also differ: left is null if argument or OC_comments is missing, while right is null only if both title and argument are missing.
